content.short: Karsa offers multi-currency business and personal accounts with cards and stablecoin transfers in emerging markets.
content.description: Karsa is a fintech, backed by Y Combinator, that gives entrepreneurs and businesses in emerging markets multi-currency accounts, cards and cross-border payments. Users can hold balances in currencies including USD, EUR, GBP and the USDT stablecoin, receive money from platforms like Stripe, Shopify and Upwork, and send payouts to more than 80 countries over ACH, wire, SWIFT, SEPA and stablecoin rails. Karsa focuses on e-commerce resellers, freelancers and companies in markets such as Pakistan, Nigeria, Vietnam and Bangladesh that struggle to access global banking. It pairs traditional and stablecoin rails so customers can get paid and pay suppliers internationally.
